scope: Independent visual series review of five selected reference-v3 PNGs against guide-v3; no generation or repair
series_caveats: These are separately generated 2D views, not five renders of one textured 3D asset. Exact window/material matching across hidden sides is not proven.
No exact metric dimensions can be certified from the finished PNGs.
South three lower arches, invented side windows, roof/gable material boundaries and low front connector roof require KK review.
Turgot 1739 roof interpretation does not itself establish unchanged appearance in1786.

historical_approval.boundary: Visual QA checks direction, silhouette, framing, main roofs/towers and obvious false openings only. It does not certify historical reconstruction, unseen facades, window count, colors, chronology or suitability for final Tripo production. No Tripo approval is inferred.

Exact stone/slate division on complex left north gable is an interpretation
